items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (envelope copy) states formal service ('zugest. am') on 23.11.2026 (Monday) under § 182 ZPO — this is actual, documented service, not deemed delivery, so the period runs from that stated day. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (23.11.) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG, counted per § 43 StPO/§ 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) starts 24.11.2026 and ends two weeks later, on Monday 07.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). 07.12.2026 is a normal working day in Niedersachsen, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The Einspruch must be received (not just sent) by the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, fees and delivery costs)
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) only if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 07.12.2026; it becomes final the next day, 08.12.2026. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day it becomes final (08.12.) is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts 09.12.2026 and ends two weeks later on Tuesday 22.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). 22.12.2026 is a normal working day in Niedersachsen, so no shift applies. This date assumes no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch would restart the proceedings and suspend this due date.

warnings: The payment due date (22.12.2026) is only correct if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; filing an Einspruch suspends both the finality (Rechtskraft) of the Bescheid and this payment deadline until the objection is resolved.

The sender's city name (Musterwilhelmshaven), the recipient's address (Beispielstede) and the e-mail domain ('.example') all look like placeholder/sample data rather than a real authority — double-check the sender's real identity, address and IBAN before paying, especially via the printed e-mail or phone number rather than relying on this letter alone.

The IBAN (DE68 2825 0110 0002 6382 00) is a structurally valid German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not confirm who owns the account; verify the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory payee-name check before transferring money.
